matches.title: My return to TDS after 2 years, and my opinion on all 6 main gamemodes + Hardcore mode.
matches.snippet: I haven't played TDS in nearly two entire years, only returning for like 5 minutes to see what changed. I've only gotten back into this game about a week ago, but I've caught up with practically everything already. The only time I'll ever touch this gamemode is if I need to beat a map multiple times for an achievement, because this gamemode is the fastest for doing so. Casual: There's nearly zero point in playing this outside of logbooks/the achievement for beating it for the first time. Just like how it was back in 2021 with just Easy, Molten, and Fallen, you will almost never play this. Intermediate: Again, no point in playing this aside from getting logbooks. I can't even say anything else about it. Molten: I remember when this mode used to be the meta for coin/exp farming, and now nobody plays it anymore. Why is that? matches.title: Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers
matches.snippet: 9. Brawler. Decent for speedrunning. That's all. 8. Necromancer. Very map and mode dependent, great for HC, VC and PW2, but pretty useless besides that. 7. Accelerator. Outclassed by every DPS tower except Turret and Pursuit. 6. Engineer. Jack Of All Trades, Master Of None. Struggles in early-game, mid-game and late-game, very support-unfriendly, was useful in LHC and LFM, but not in their modern versions. 5. Operator. Extremely good early, and holds up pretty well till the late game, but has alternatives like G Soldier, which can be even better. 4. Enforcer. Map and modes dependent (sucks in Frost, shines at Pizza Party and Fallen). Crazy damage and CE plus stuns, though short range. 3. Hacker. The only good HC tower. Multiple strong abilities, very versatile and useful, can increase your DPS drastically with it's clones and doesn't even need to be upgraded to level 5, but is very expensiive and loadout-dependent. 2. Juggernaut. Extremely good for mini/final boss/bosses and for overall damage on Bottom Path, and very strong support and Cost Efficient on Top Path + has hidden and flying/lead. Kingpin. Crazy DPS, strong eco, versatility, 2 detections + 1 semi-detection. Good practically everywhere. Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers
